validity_rules.rule1_fischer_differs_from_live: Realized dream meanings must differ from the live regime at suspension. Runs where dream == live_regime are excluded.
validity_rules.rule2_mal_differs_on_uncollected: Mal controlled mismatch must differ from dream on at least one uncollected object in the suspended state.
validity_rules.rule3_mal_differs_from_live: Mal outer target must differ from the live regime at suspension. Runs where mal_target == live_regime are excluded.
